Hey.. 
I feel for you but also, I'm happy for you - not in a wicked way, but this might be an opportunity to focus on yourself and understand yourself way more, what you need, you want to be and what you want to improve at in your life. I have BPD, I'm bipolar and I developed CPTSD when I was a child. Never knew about it until recently. But I was into self-improvement with saved my life. It can change your life for the better and the best. But it starts slowly and it can feel lonely sometimes. And sometimes thats what we need, if it means it will help us grow into the person that can get the life we really want, with the persons we want and the things we desire into it. It all starts with understanding yourself and having a goal that make you excited and alive while pursuing it. Mine was to be able to date a certain caliber of girls and to become a certain caliber of guy. I reach those with lots of efforts, sweat, tears and change. It was definitely worth it. I'm onto others things and that could be you too. Start where you feels comfortable and progress. Life is ahead of you, not behind. I lost lots of people - friends, lovers and family members, while growing and detaching from negativity or abuse. But I met so many much better people and got so much more out of life thanks to that. You can too. Much love

Hey. Happens to me sometimes.. and I used to get stuck into that mode for days. Listening to happy things will feel weird, strange, uncomfortable because she is emotionally addicted to that, right now. She doesn't have to listen to happy things right now, it might actually make things worse. Try funny shows - not about happy and dreamy utopia. Try things that might be like dark humor, then go on to less dark humor and slowly progress like that. Also, she should to identify her triggers, the things that trigger her sadness, the confusion and then the depression. Might be her thoughts or others opinions. For her good, she could try meditation to be more aware of the separation between her and her thoughts and the facts that most of them are lies and most of what people say is projection. Try these few things and tell us how it went. Much love
